title: Show HN: Are You in the Weights?
summary: A web application that queries multiple frontier and small AI/LLM models in parallel to test how strongly they recognize individual users, clustering responses to measure recognition levels and explore the concept of data 'in the weights' of trained models.
problem_solved: Helps users discover whether and to what extent their information has been learned by AI models during training.
why_valuable: Raises awareness about personal data presence in AI models and the privacy implications of large-scale training data.
